headline: Bruins hit the road for Frozen Frenzy while Patriots navigate injury woes
morning_brew: It is a hell of a busy night for the NHL as the Frozen Frenzy takes center stage, and our Bruins are heading all the way out to San Jose to clash with the Sharks. Being out west makes for a late one here in the Hub, but these are the nights you live for when every team in the league is hitting the ice at once. We need the boys to bring that high energy from the drop of the puck because points are gonna be at a premium in this shortened season.

Football season isn't giving us a breather either, with some real bad news regarding TreVeyon Henderson. Finding out he is set to miss a significant chunk of time with an ankle injury is a massive blow to the run game that we were just starting to feel good about. Coach is gonna have to get creative with the backfield depth we have on the roster, because the Jets are coming to Foxborough this weekend and we need every yard we can scratch out to keep this winning streak alive.

I am still keeping an eye on the baseball playoffs even if the Sox aren't the ones making headlines this time around. It is a strange feeling watching the postseason from the couch without our boys, but the league is buzzing with chatter about potential MVPs and where teams go from here. No matter what is happening on the diamond or the gridiron, we just have to keep moving forward and hope the training room starts emptying out before the winter sets in for good.

news_digest.headline: Sources: Patriots' TreVeyon Henderson out multiple weeks with high ankle sprain
news_digest.dans_take: Losing a back like that hurts, so we better hope the depth chart can hold the line or I might lose my mind.
